idea-plugin.name: Periwinkle Night Theme
idea-plugin.description:
The dark sibling of Periwinkle Islands: deep indigo chrome with clearly separated panels, soft white text and a calm editor palette in clearly separated pastels: lilac keywords, cyan types, gold methods, peach strings and green comments, with names in plain text. Shared semantic colours for C#, Java, Kotlin, Go and Python in Rider, IntelliJ IDEA, GoLand and PyCharm.

Designed for the Islands UI in JetBrains IDEs 2026.2 or later. Mapped text colours are checked for contrast.
